documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Rajputana Biodiesel Limited reported its financial results for FY26, with revenue from operations reaching 12,202.92 Lakhs. The company operates two biodiesel manufacturing facilities with an aggregate capacity of 170 KLPD and has supply contracts with major OMCs like HPCL, BPCL, and IOCL. Management highlighted the acquisition of Nirvaanraj Energy Private Limited and the incorporation of Rajputana Agro LLP to secure its feedstock supply chain. Additionally, the company has secured government approvals for two CBG units in Rajasthan and achieved Verra Carbon Credit Certification. Rajputana Biodiesel Limited discussed its H1 FY26 performance, highlighting significant operational developments and expansion plans.

guidance.claim: Management expects H2 FY26 financial performance to be heavier than H1 FY26.
guidance.quote: Our H2 numbers will be heavier than H1 numbers.

guidance.claim: The company aims to produce 130 to 150 kilolitres per day starting from the coming financial year.
guidance.quote: From April onwards, from coming April onwards, our bids in the OMC tender would be as per our enhanced capacity and we are aiming to produce 130 to 150 kilolitres per day from the coming financial year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to complete previous biodiesel allocations worth approximately INR 100 crores by the end of November 2025.
guidance.quote: By November end of this year, we would be completing our previous biodiesel allocations of approximately INR100 crores.

guidance.claim: The company is on track to achieve its goal of becoming a one-stop solution for renewable energy across the solid, liquid, and gas segments.
guidance.quote: We are absolutely on track to fulfil our vision and mission in becoming a one-stop solution for renewable energy in the Solid, Liquid and Gas segments.

demand_outlook.claim: There is a structural supply gap of over 5,200 ML of biodiesel and 14.5 MMT of CBG by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: Structural supply gaps: >5,200 ML biodiesel & 14.5 MMT CBG deficit by 2030

demand_outlook.claim: The National Biofuels Policy of 2018 sets an indicative target of blending 5% biodiesel into diesel.
demand_outlook.quote: As per National Biofuels Policy of 2018, there is an indicative target of blending 5% biodiesel into diesel.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the 5% biodiesel blending target presents an industry opportunity size of around INR 45,000 crores to INR 50,000 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: It has the potential of an industry of around INR 45,000 crores to INR 50,000 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has recently received large-scale orders from government PSUs.
demand_outlook.quote: The recent large-scale orders from government PSUs, investments in capacity expansion, technological upgrades at biodiesel plants, along with our entry into the CBG and Pellets segment, collectively reaffirm our strategic roadmap toward becoming a comprehensive and integrated BioEnergy company.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has enhanced capacity at its Phulera and Meerut units by almost 3 to 4 times.
capex_expansion.quote: We have successfully enhanced capacity at our Phulera and Meerut units by almost 3-4 times.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has received approvals to establish two compressed biogas units in Rajasthan.
capex_expansion.quote: As mentioned in our annual report also, for those who have missed the annual report or not gone through it, we have received approvals for establishing two compressed biogas units in the state of Rajasthan.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning a 150 metric tons per day biodiesel plant in the GCC region.
capex_expansion.quote: We are planning a plant of 150 metric tons in GCC region which will produce biodiesel.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired Nirvaanraj Energy Private Limited, which has an 80 KLPD capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Acquisition of Nirvaanraj Energy Private Limited (80 KLPD capacity)

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding its operations into CBG and biomass pellets.

margins_costs.claim: The company's cost of materials consumed stood at 10,994.97 Lakhs in FY26.
Rajputana Agro LLP provides a captive feedstock supply chain to reduce input cost volatility for CBG plants.
margins_costs.quote: Strategic Role: Provides a captive, integrated feedstock supply chain — reducing input cost volatility and securing raw material availability for CBG plants at Ajmer and Nagaur.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins in the CBG sector to be more than 55% to 60%.
margins_costs.quote: But trust me, the EBITDA margins are more than 55%-60% in the CBG sector.

margins_costs.claim: By using captive Napier grass feedstock, the company expects CBG EBITDA margins of 65% to 70%.
margins_costs.quote: Hence, we are having EBITDA of more than 65%–70% in the CBG sector.

margins_costs.claim: The company's captive feedstock cost for CBG is almost half of external market landed costs.
margins_costs.quote: Our cost of feedstock is almost half of what is available in the market, at the same gas percent yield.

margins_costs.claim: The company's cost of material consumed stood at Rs 47.96 crore for H1 FY26 compared to Rs 32.95 crore in H1 FY25.

orders_capacity.claim: The company submitted its highest ever volume bid in the current OMC biodiesel tender for November 2025 to March 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: I am very delighted to share that the current OMC's biodiesel tender for the period of November to March 2026 is out and really glad to share with you that we have bid the highest volume of biodiesel supply ever in our history.

orders_capacity.claim: September performance reflects April to July allocations, whereas August to October allocations will reflect in October and November performance.
orders_capacity.quote: So, September numbers reflect April to July allocations And the August, September and October allocations will reflects in our October and November performance.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has secured long-term supply contracts with major oil marketing companies including HPCL, BPCL, and IOCL.
orders_capacity.quote: Long-term supply contracts with OMC's (HPCL, BPCL and IOCL)

orders_capacity.claim: The company has received large-scale orders from government PSUs.
orders_capacity.quote: The recent large-scale orders from government PSUs, investments in capacity expansion, technological upgrades at biodiesel plants, along with our entry into the CBG and Pellets segment, collectively reaffirm our strategic roadmap toward becoming a comprehensive and integrated BioEnergy company.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's long-term borrowings decreased to 417.45 Lakhs in FY26.
The company's net cash from operating activities was negative 284.70 Lakhs in FY26.
The company utilized its IPO capital for working capital, technical upgradation, and capacity enhancement.
capital_allocation.quote: We successfully utilized the capital raised in our IPO for immediate working capital needs and technical upgradation along with capacity enhancement.

capital_allocation.claim: Management plans to execute a preferential round to raise capital for the GCC and CBG units.
capital_allocation.quote: We are planning to go for a preferential round in the times to come for raising money for the GCC unit and the CBG unit.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's strategic roadmap includes the deleveraging of its balance sheet.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management identified feedstock availability as the primary operational challenge in the CBG industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: The biggest challenge in this business is that people don’t have enough feedstock to produce.

risks_headwinds.claim: Exorbitant freight costs and poor shipping traffic at Mundra and Kandla hinder direct biodiesel exports from India to Europe.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because freight costs from India to Europe are exorbitant. There is not enough traffic at Mundra and Kandla, you don't find ships.

management_commitments.claim: Management is focused on creating long-term shareholder value through sustainable and scalable energy solutions.
management_commitments.quote: We remain focused on creating long-term shareholder value through sustainable and scalable energy solutions.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to produce 130 to 150 kilolitres per day starting from FY27.
management_commitments.quote: From April onwards, from coming April onwards, our bids in the OMC tender would be as per our enhanced capacity and we are aiming to produce 130 to 150 kilolitres per day from the coming financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to start civil work for its compressed biogas project by January end.
management_commitments.quote: By January end, we are looking to start the civil work of this compressed biogas project.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to begin civil work for its GCC export unit project by January end.
management_commitments.quote: By January end, we will be beginning the civil work for this project also.

management_commitments.claim: The company is working towards fulfilling its vision of becoming a one-stop solution for renewable energy in the solid, liquid, and gas segments.
management_commitments.quote: We are absolutely on track to fulfil our vision and mission in becoming a one-stop solution for renewable energy in the Solid, Liquid and Gas segments.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
